title: MBAPPE WAS OFFSIDE SEVEN TIMES AND STILL WON EL CLASICO
description:
Mourinho on his knees, Mbappe on the scoresheet, and one very busy linesman.

Real Madrid won 2-1 at Camp Nou, their first win there in three years. That ended Barcelona's nine-game La Liga winning run.

Mbappe scored a deflected opener in the 41st minute, then the winner in the 87th. He was flagged offside seven times, the most by any player in a major European league in six years. Camavinga's run set up the winner.

Mourinho complained that VAR did not check a challenge, then celebrated by sliding on his knees. Barcelona stay top, Atletico two points back.

Was Mourinho right to want that challenge checked? Say it in the comments.
